description: This Java class 'AdminServerContainer' implements a server container that manages an admin socket for an OFBiz instance, allowing remote commands such as status inquiries and shutdown requests. It handles socket communication, command parsing, and server lifecycle management.

classes.name: AdminServerContainer
classes.description: A container class that manages an admin socket server for OFBiz, enabling remote commands such as shutdown and status.

classes.name: OfbizSocketCommand
classes.description: An enum defining socket commands: SHUTDOWN, STATUS, FAIL.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the server socket and thread for the admin server, configuring network parameters.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server thread if it is running.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container.

methods.name: processClientRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming client requests, processes commands, and sends responses.

methods.name: determineClientCommand
methods.description: Parses the client request string to determine the command.

methods.name: isValidRequest
methods.description: Validates the format and authenticity of the request string.

methods.name: prepareResponseToClient
methods.description: Prepares a response string based on the server state and command.
